_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Black Road Runaround#001.src: 'Ey, there, kid! I heard ol' Enkser gave ya yer first horse! That feller's a tight one, so consider it lucky ya got it fer free.
Black Road Runaround#001.dst: おい、坊や！　あの Enkser おじさんが、お前に初めての馬をくれたって聞いたぞ！　あいつはケチな奴だから、タダでもらえたのはラッキーだと思えよ。
Black Road Runaround#001.speaker: Stablehand

Black Road Runaround#002.src: Say, d'ya wanna play a little game to get more familiar with yer steed? 's called a Time Trial.
Black Road Runaround#002.dst: ねえ、自分の愛馬ともっと親しくなるために、ちょっとしたゲームをやってみないか？　「{c2}タイムトライアル{/}」ってやつだよ。
Black Road Runaround#002.speaker: Stablehand

Black Road Runaround#003.src: I've made a track 'round the local area. A few folks've tried it out, includin' Enkser, who holds the record. Him and 'is Betty're a force t'be reckoned with, I tells ya.
Black Road Runaround#003.dst: 近所を周回するコースを作ってみたんだ。何人かが試走してくれたんだけど、その中には記録保持者の Enkser もいたよ。あいつと「Betty」は、本当に手強い相手だぜ、本当に。
Black Road Runaround#003.speaker: Stablehand

Black Road Runaround#004.src: Dependin' on yer time, y'can get different rewards. Emeralds, gear, and if ya beat Enkser's time (A-Rank), even another horse! It's a bet he made.
Black Road Runaround#004.dst: 走破時間次第で、{c2}さまざまな報酬{/}が手に入る。エメラルドや装備、そして {c3}Enkser の記録(Aランク){/}を上回れば、さらに別の馬まで手に入る！　これは彼が賭けたものなんです。
Black Road Runaround#004.speaker: Stablehand

Black Road Runaround#005.src: Best of all, it'll help make yer steed stronger. So how about it, kid? Want to try it out? If you do, talk to me again.
Black Road Runaround#005.dst: 何より、これで{c2}君の愛馬がもっと強くなる{/}んだ。どうだ、坊や？ 試してみるか？ もし試してみたいなら、{c2}また俺に声をかけてくれ{/}。
Black Road Runaround#005.speaker: Stablehand
Black Road Runaround#005.note: {c2}make yer steed stronger{/} , {c2}talk to me again{/}

Black Road Runaround#006.src: It's a note from Enkser... Read it?
Black Road Runaround#006.dst: Enkser からのメモだ…読んでみる？

Black Road Runaround#007.src: Welp, I'm a man of my word. I lost the bet, so to the victor go the spoils - the daughter of my precious Betty. You take good care of her, hear?
Black Road Runaround#007.dst: {c1}まあ、俺は約束を守る男だ。賭けに負けたから、勝者には景品が与えられる――俺の愛しい Betty の娘だ。彼女をちゃんと大切にしてやってくれよ、いいか？{/}
Black Road Runaround#007.note: {c1}Welp, I'm a man of my word. I lost the bet, so to the victor go the spoils - the daughter of my precious Betty. You take good care of her, hear?{/}

Black Road Runaround#008.src: I suspect you might be wanting to breed her with that other horse I gave you before. It's a good idea; their offspring will have a higher Potential.
Black Road Runaround#008.dst: {c1}たぶん、前に私があげたあの馬と、その{c2}牝馬を交配{c1}させたいと思っているんじゃないか。それはいい考えだ。そうすれば、その子馬の「{c2}潜在能力{c1}」は高くなるだろうから。{/}
Black Road Runaround#008.note: {c1}I suspect you might be wanting to {c2}breed her{c1} with that other horse I gave you before. It's a good idea; their offspring will have a {c2}higher Potential{c1}.{/}

Black Road Runaround#009.src: A Mount's Potential is basically the sum of all of its Max stats. The higher the Potential, the greater your horse can become.
Black Road Runaround#009.dst: {c1}馬の「ポテンシャル」は、基本的にその馬のすべての{c2}最大ステータス{c1}の合計だ。ポテンシャルが高いほど、その馬はより優れた馬へと成長することができる。{/}
Black Road Runaround#009.note: {c1}A Mount's Potential is basically the sum of all of its {c2}Max stats{c1}. The higher the Potential, the greater your horse can become.{/}

Black Road Runaround#010.src: If you want to breed a mount, just go to the mount feeder and place the saddle of one mount into the other's trough. Yes, it's weird. Don't ask.
Black Road Runaround#010.dst: {c1}マウントを繁殖させたい場合は、{c2}給餌器{c1}に行き、{c2}一方のマウントの鞍をもう一方の餌箱に入れるだけ{c1}だ。ああ、ちょっと変だが理由は聞かないでくれ。{/}
Black Road Runaround#010.note: {c1}If you want to breed a mount, just go to the {c2}mount feeder{c1} and {c2}place the saddle of one mount into the other's trough{c1}. Yes, it's weird. Don't ask.{/}

Black Road Runaround#011.src: Be warned though - in the process of becoming parents, the two horses you had before will have to retire. We'll take them into our care, and you'll not be able to use them anymore.
Black Road Runaround#011.dst: {c1}ただし、ひとつ注意しておけ。親になる過程で、{c2}以前飼っていた2頭の馬{c1}は引退することになる。私たちがお引き取りし、あなたたちは{c2}もうそれらを使うことはできない。{/}
Black Road Runaround#011.note: {c1}Be warned though - in the process of becoming parents, the {c2}two horses you had before{c1} will have to retire. We'll take them into our care, and you'll {c2}not be able to use them anymore.{/}

Black Road Runaround#012.src: That should be all. If you have any more questions, I left you a book about Mount rearing in the Bank across from the Enclosure. Be good to that horse for me, okay?
Black Road Runaround#012.dst: {c1}これで全部のはずだ。もし他に質問があれば、{c2}囲い{c1}の向かいにある{c2}銀行{c1}に、馬の飼育に関する{c2}本{c1}を置いといた。私の分も、その馬を大切にしてくれ。{/}
Black Road Runaround#012.note: {c1}That should be all. If you have any more questions, I left you a {c2}book{c1} about Mount rearing in the {c2}Bank{c1} across from {c2}the Enclosure{c1}. Be good to that horse for me, okay?{/}
